N362444  
July 7, 2026
  CLA-2-63:OT:RR:NC:N3:349  
CATEGORY: Classification  
TARIFF NO.: 6304.92.0000; 6304.99.3500
  Ms. Michelle Yamajako  MIYA  10 Rue De Londres  Chatou  78400  France  RE:  The tariff classification of decorative pillow covers from France  Dear Ms. Yamajako:  In your letter dated June 14, 2026, you requested a tariff classification ruling.  In lieu of samples,  photographs were submitted with your request.  Item 1, identified as ZANZIBAR No 53, is a decorative pillow cover measuring 20 x 20 inches, designed to  encase a removable pillow insert, imported separately.  The decorative pillow cover is made of piece-dyed,   100 percent henequen woven fabric.  The article features a self-flange, knife edge, center back envelope  closure, and two gold-toned metal eyelets (grommets).  When looking at the front of the cover, the eyelets  appear in the upper left-hand corner of the cover, one along the top edge and one on the left edge.  A  gold-toned stainless-steel chain with a leather ‘MIYA’ brand accent tab is threaded through the eyelets and  the ends are secured at the back of the cover.  A decorative organza ribbon bow and charms consisting of  beads, metal pendants, natural shells and a leather tassel hang from the metal chain on the front side of the  cover.  Though the chain with charms is removable, it is intended solely for use as a decorative accessory to  the cushion cover.  This cover is part of the MIYA brand signature tassel series and is imported without the  inner cushion insert.  Item 2, identified as NEGRIL No 39, is a decorative pillow cover measuring 20 x 20 inches, designed to  encase a removable pillow insert, imported separately.  The decorative pillow cover is made of piece-dyed,   100 percent hemp woven fabric.  The article features a self-flange, knife edge, center back envelope closure,  and two gold-toned metal eyelets (grommets).  When looking at the front of the cover, the eyelets appear in  the upper right-hand corner of the cover, one along the top edge and one on the right edge.  A gold-toned  stainless-steel chain with a leather ‘MIYA’ brand accent tab is threaded through the eyelets and the ends are  secured at the back of the cover.  A decorative organza ribbon bow and charms consisting of beads, metal  pendants, natural shells and a leather tassel hang from the metal chain on the front side of the cover.  Though  the chain with charms is removable, it is intended solely for use as a decorative accessory to the cushion 

cover.  This cover is part of the MIYA brand signature tassel series and is imported without the inner cushion  insert.  Item 3, identified as BALI No 14, is a decorative pillow cover measuring 20 x 20 inches, designed to encase  a removable pillow insert, imported separately.  The decorative pillow cover is made of piece-dyed, 55  percent linen, 35 percent wool, and 10 percent nylon woven fabric.  The article features a self-flange, knife  edge, center back envelope closure, and two gold-toned metal eyelets (grommets).  When looking at the front  of the cover, the eyelets appear in the upper left-hand corner of the cover, one along the top edge and one on  the left edge.  A gold-toned stainless-steel chain with a leather ‘MIYA’ brand accent tab is threaded through  the eyelets and the ends are secured at the back of the cover.  A decorative organza ribbon bow and charms  consisting of beads, metal pendants, natural shells and a leather tassel hang from the metal chain on the front  side of the cover.  Though the chain with charms is removable, it is intended solely for use as a decorative  accessory to the cushion cover.  This cover is part of the MIYA brand signature tassel series and is imported  without the inner cushion insert.  Item 4, identified as NEGRIL No 03, is a decorative pillow cover measuring 20 x 20 inches, designed to  encase a removable pillow insert, imported separately.  The decorative pillow cover is made of piece-dyed,  63 percent cotton and 37 percent linen, woven fabric.  The article features a self-flange, knife edge, center  back envelope closure, and two gold-toned metal eyelets (grommets).  When looking at the front of the cover,  the eyelets appear in the upper right-hand corner of the cover, one along the top edge and one on the right  edge.  A gold-toned stainless-steel chain with a leather ‘MIYA’ brand accent tab is threaded through the  eyelets and the ends are secured at the back of the cover.  A decorative organza ribbon bow and charms  consisting of beads, metal pendants, natural shells and a leather tassel hang from the metal chain on the front  side of the cover.  Though the chain with charms is removable, it is intended solely for use as a decorative  accessory to the cushion cover.  This cover is part of the MIYA brand signature tassel series and is imported  without the inner cushion insert.  Item 5, identified as MARRAKECH No 49, is a decorative pillow cover measuring 20 x 20 inches, designed  to encase a removable pillow insert, imported separately.  The decorative pillow cover is made of piece-dyed,  91 percent linen and 9 percent nylon woven fabric.  The article features a self-flange, knife edge, center back  envelope closure, and two gold-toned metal eyelets (grommets).  When looking at the front of the cover, the  eyelets appear in the upper left-hand corner of the cover, one along the top edge and one on the left edge.  A  gold-toned stainless-steel chain with a leather ‘MIYA’ brand accent tab is threaded through the eyelets and  the ends are secured at the back of the cover.  A decorative organza ribbon bow and charms consisting of  beads, metal pendants, natural shells and a leather tassel hang from the metal chain on the front side of the  cover.  Though the chain with charms is removable, it is intended solely for use as a decorative accessory to  the cushion cover.  This cover is part of the MIYA brand signature tassel series and is imported without the  inner cushion insert.  The applicable subheading for the decorative pillow cover, described as NEGRIL No 03 will be  6304.92.0000, Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), which provides for “Other  furnishing articles, excluding those of heading 9404:  Other:  Not knitted or crocheted, of cotton.”  The  general rate of duty will be 6.3 percent ad valorem.  The applicable subheading for the decorative pillow cover, described as ZANZIBAR No 53, NEGRIL No 39,  BALI No 14, and MARRAKECH No 49 will be 6304.99.3500, HTSUS, which provides for “Other  furnishing articles, excluding those of heading 9404:  Other: Not knitted or crocheted, of other textile  materials:  Other:  Other.”  The general rate of duty will be 11.3 percent ad valorem.  The duties cited above are current as of this ruling’s issuance.  Duty rates are provided for your convenience  and are subject to change.  The text of the most recent HTSUS and the accompanying duty rates are provided  at https://hts.usitc.gov/. 

This ruling does not address the applicability of any additional duties, taxes, fees, exactions and/or other  charges, which may apply to the goods discussed herein.  This includes, but is not limited to, tariffs and other  duties as provided for in Subchapter III to Chapter 99, HTSUS.  Thus, for example, in addition to the  classification stated above, the merchandise covered by this ruling may also need to be reported with either  the Chapter 99 provision under which an additional tariff applies or one of the Chapter 99 provisions  covering exceptions to such tariffs.  For further information to assist with the importation process, please refer to the frequently updated Cargo  Systems Messaging Service (CSMS) messages at   https://www.cbp.gov/trade/automated/cargo-systems-messaging-service and the Trade Remedies page at   https://www.cbp.gov/trade/programs-administration/trade-remedies.  The holding set forth above applies only to the specific factual situation and merchandise description as  identified in the ruling request.  This position is clearly set forth in Title 19, Code of Federal Regulations  (CFR), Section 177.9(b)(1).  This section states that a ruling letter is issued on the assumption that all of the  information furnished in the ruling letter, whether directly, by reference, or by implication, is accurate and  complete in every material respect.  In the event that the facts are modified in any way, or if the goods do not  conform to these facts at time of importation, you should bring this to the attention of U.S. Customs and  Border Protection (CBP) and submit a request for a new ruling in accordance with 19 CFR 177.2.  Additionally, we note that the material facts described in the foregoing ruling may be subject to periodic  verification by CBP.  This ruling is being issued under the provisions of Part 177 of the Customs and Border Protection  Regulations (19 C.F.R. 177).  A copy of the ruling or the control number indicated above should be provided with the entry documents  filed at the time this merchandise is imported.  If you have any questions regarding the ruling, please contact  National Import Specialist Kim Wachtel at kimberly.a.wachtel@cbp.dhs.gov.  
Sincerely,
  (for)  James P. Forkan  Director  National Commodity Specialist Division
